text:
By Ananya Mallick ,
45 minutes ago
Cooper Flagg (Image Credits: Imagn) The Dallas Mavericks‚Äô rookie star, Cooper Flagg, continues to draw attention as one of the league‚Äôs brightest young talents and a strong contender for top honors. However, one of the most talked-about NBA players in the 2026 power ranking is dealing with a left midfoot sprain.
The injury happened during Tuesday‚Äôs loss to the Phoenix Suns. Cooper Flagg will also miss his first All-Star weekend, including the 2026 Castrol Rising Stars game in Los Angeles . The team shared that they will give more updates on his condition later. The timing may also help, as Dallas does not play again until February 20 against the Minnesota Timberwolves.
The Mavericks star was drafted No. 1 overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft. Cooper Flagg played 49 games this season and averaged 20.4 points, 6.5 rebounds, 4.1 assists, and 1.2 steals while shooting 48.2% from the field and 30.2% from the three-point line. Those numbers highlight Cooper Flagg as the brightest spot within the Mavericks‚Äô core.
As the rookie star will miss the 2026 NBA Rising Stars game, here are the three potential players who could step in and take his place :
1. Ace Bailey Ace Bailey (Image Credits: Imagn) Bailey has been a strong contributor for the Utah Jazz this season, appearing in 47 games. He is averaging 11.6 points in 26.1 minutes per game, showing his strong offensive ability. The 19-year-old shoots 44.7% from the field and 33.8 % from three-point range. He also contributes on the boards and helps create opportunities for his teammates with steady playmaking.
2. Ryan Kalkbrenner Ryan Kalkbrenner (Image Credits: Imagn) Kalkbrenner remains a steady presence for the Charlotte Hornets this season. While playing 43 games this season, and averaged 8.2 points in just under 23 minutes per game. Kalkbrenner is shooting an impressive 75.8% from the field, making him a reliable scorer inside. He also provided solid rebounding and, defensively, protects the rim, adding value with his 1.5 blocks per game average.
3. Maxime Raynaud Maxime Raynaud (Image Credits: Imagn) Raynaud is a dependable contributor for the Sacramento Kings during the 2025-26 season. He is averaging 9.9 points in 23.4 minutes per game across 47 appearances. Raynaud is shooting an efficient 55.5% from the field, showing his strength around the basket. In addition, he chips in with rebounding and steady defensive effort when called upon. His steady production made him a reliable piece in the Kings‚Äô rotation.
